        Circle(top_radius)

v_width = 2 * v_depth * math.tan(v_half_angle_rad)

    hole = Pos(x_pos, chute_width/2, chute_height/2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, chute_width)

    solid_body = solid_body - hole
